elements.note: THE TALL STAIRWELL WINDOW, 3.55 m high -- fixed lights above a pair of awning sashes, in two 0.80 m panels. Its level is given not as a figure but as 'ระดับพื้นชานพัก', the stair landing floor.

warnings: *** THE WINDOW SCHEDULE, AND WITH A-22 IT FULLY RESOLVES THE OPENING-MARK AMBIGUITY CARRIED SINCE A-05. *** Doors are numbered 1-5 (A-22) and windows 1-6 (here). So a mark 6 anywhere on the plans or elevations is necessarily a WINDOW, and marks 1-5 are ambiguous by number alone -- they must be read from the symbol shape (circle = door, pentagon = window per A-01). The opening_mark_set entries on A-05, A-06 and the elevations can now be narrowed on that basis.

*** THE 0.45 M SILL ON WINDOWS 1, 2 AND 3 IS THE A-03 BRIEF MADE REAL. *** A-03 asks for 'ระดับหน้าต่างสูงจากพื้นประมาณ 45 ซม เพื่อให้สามารถเห็นทัศนียภาพภายนอก' -- a sill low enough to see out of while seated. Windows 1-3 have exactly that, achieved with a 0.40 m fixed light below the opening sash. Window 4 has no lower light and sits at 0.85 m; windows 5 and 6 are high-level.

EVERY WINDOW IS ALUMINIUM: white powder-coated frame and sash with 6 mm green tinted glass, matching door 1 and มอก. 284-2530. Not one UPVC window in the set, although four of the five doors are UPVC.
Heads line up at 2.05 m on windows 1-5, the same head height as every door. Only window 6 breaks it.

WINDOW 6 IS THE ODD ONE OUT IN EVERY WAY: 3.55 m tall, in two 0.80 m panels, and its level is given as 'ระดับพื้นชานพัก' (the stair landing) rather than as a number, because it spans between floors in the stairwell. It is the mark 6 seen on the plans.
Three hardware sets are used and each matches its opening type -- sliding, casement and awning -- all 'อลูมิเนียมครบชุด'.
